EDUCATION
Marri Laxman Reddy Institute of Technology and Management
Hyderabad, India
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning)
Dec 2020 – Aug 2024
• Percentage: 76.8% – First Class with Distinction
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming Languages & Web Technologies: Python (Proficient), Java, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
Frameworks & Libraries: Flask, FastAPI, Django, React.js
Development Tools & Platforms: Git, GitHub, GitLab, VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity
Database & Cloud Technologies: MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Render, Netlify
Development Methodologies: Agile (Scrum), Test-Driven Development (TDD)
WORK EXPERIENCE
Freelance Frontend Developer | Remote
Feb 2025 – Aug 2025
• Delivered responsive UIs for multiple clients using React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript.
• Applied Agile (Scrum) workflows by incorporating client feedback in short iterations and delivering production-ready designs.
• Collaborated with clients and a senior teammate to refine requirements and resolve responsiveness issues across devices.
• Recent work: Yuga IAS
↗– developed a landing page and UI components with high-resolution desktop optimization (HD, Full HD, 2K, 4K).
PROJECTS
CodeArena – AI-Powered Multiplayer Coding Platform
↗| FastAPI, Judge0 API, Gemini API, Render, Netlify
Sep 2025 – Feb 2026
• Built a real-time multiplayer coding platform using Python, FastAPI, and WebSockets supporting 100 concurrent users(up to 5 players per
room) with synchronized timers and dynamic leaderboards.
• Integrated Judge0 for sandboxed execution in 4 languages (Python, Java, Go, JS) and Google Gemini for AI-based time-complexity analysis
with 50% partial-point scoring for TLE submissions.
• Deployed a secure, high-performance backend with API proxying, CORS restrictions, environment-based secrets, and full CI/CD pipelines;
achieved a 250ms average response time under a 500-request load test.
• Resolved critical production-level challenges including WebSocket race conditions (by reconfiguring Gunicorn to a single worker) and
in-memory state loss (by implementing a persistent uptime monitor), ensuring 24/7 service reliability.
Codenames Online – Real-Time Multiplayer Web Game
↗| React.js, Firebase, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript
May 2025 – Aug 2025
• Architected full-stack real-time multiplayer web application using React.js and Firebase Firestore with complex game state management.
• Built React hooks, real-time chat functionality, automated team assignment logic, and turn-based gameplay mechanics.
• Configured 4-player game mechanics with automatic team balancing, role-based access control, and session persistence.
• Crafted UI with Tailwind CSS featuring interactive game board and lobby system; deployed on Netlify with Firebase security rules.
Tridle – 3-Word Wordle Variant Game
↗| React.js, JavaScript, CSS3, Python
Jan 2025 – Mar 2025
• Pioneered a Wordle-based puzzle game where players solve three five-letter puzzles simultaneously using React component architecture.
• Designed a virtual keyboard, color-coded feedback system, and theme toggling using React hooks with smooth CSS transitions.
• Integrated persistent player statistics (games played, wins, win %) using localStorage and implemented a ’Play Again’ flow which generates
new puzzle sets for replayability.
• Complemented frontend with a Python console version for puzzle generation & well-structured state management for multi-board gameplay.
Other Projects: Football Arena – Ultimate Goals Challenge
↗, Star Showdown – Higher or Lower Game
↗
CERTIFICATIONS
HackerRank Certifications: Python (Basic), Java (Basic), SQL (Basic), Problem Solving (Basic), Problem Solving (Intermediate), Software
Engineer Intern, Software Engineer
FreeCodeCamp Certifications: Machine Learning with Python, Scientific Computing with Python, Data Analysis with Python
CISCO Networking Academy: Programming Essentials in C, Advanced Programming in C
